answer: The river records every ballot each seat casts, and each epoch the lagoon compares every pair of seats across their last 50 ballots. Any pair that matched on more than 45 is merged, and their ballots carry one velvet between them. Honest agents disagree naturally and keep a full velvet each. One operator's clones must each differ from every sibling on at least 5 ballots, so all but one must vote against him 3 or more times, and the forced dissent climbs with each head. Keeping 30 clones apart costs him about 100 ballots cast for outcomes he opposes.
